failed_controller_attempt.error: treatment execution requires reusable baseline runtime-opencode-codex-product-v1 for beets-lifecycle-sequence-v0 r2

root_cause: The generic workflow runner treated the OpenCode replacement-runtime profile as a Codex-comparison treatment. Fastify happened to have a reusable Codex r2 comparator, while Beets did not. The requested bare OpenCode control should be independently eligible as the matched control for OpenCode plugin treatments.

correction.runner_behavior: Owner-authorized runtime-opencode-codex-product-v1 r2 sessions may be retained as standalone OpenCode controls without a Codex comparison binding; all provider, protocol, verifier, compact-evidence, and isolation gates remain unchanged.
correction.validator_behavior: Only the exact runtime-opencode-codex-product-v1 standalone-control contract may omit a comparison binding.
correction.retry_policy: The rejected reservation was removed because no provider task started and no session identity was created. Re-executing Beets r2 is the first provider-backed attempt for that identity, not pass selection or a duplicate sample.
correction.fastify_disposition: The accepted Fastify r2 session is retained; it completed before the controller defect surfaced.
correction.terraform_disposition: Terraform was never launched or reserved in the rejected matrix.
